description: Send a text from an agent's phone line through the governed messaging API. Provide from_agent_id, to, and message. For the immediate confirmation a customer just requested on a booking form, add purpose: booking_confirmation, the form's actual sms_consent: true, and idempotency_key; this records service consent and allows the requested confirmation after hours. Booking alerts to this business's active admin phone use purpose: booking_alert and idempotency_key. Explicit opt-outs, content controls and rate limits remain enforced. Use dispatch_policy: queue_if_needed to defer ordinary messages outside their allowed window. Optionally link lead_id; it must belong to this business and match the recipient phone.

consent_language.description: The disclosure shown on the form, when available.

from_agent_id.description: Agent ID whose phone line the text is sent from.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key. A replay with the same key returns the original send outcome instead of sending again — so a retry after an uncertain response is safe.

lead_id.description: Optional lead ID to link and honor the lead's automation-pause state.

purpose.description: Booking confirmation attests the customer just requested this text; booking_alert requires an active business admin recipient. Requires idempotency_key.

sms_consent.description: Actual service-message opt-in captured on the booking form. Never infer or invent it.

sms_opt_in.description: Existing form consent alias, for example yes.

source_url.description: Optional HTTPS booking-form URL for consent provenance.

submission_id.description: Optional original submission ID; defaults to the idempotency key.

submitted_at.description: Optional original form-submission ISO timestamp. Must be recent for an immediate reply.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +18135551234).

name: send_sms
title: Send SMS
